remarks: Well maintained, sun filled tri-level townhouse available for rent. The main level features an eat-in kitchen, a half bath, and a bright living room with access to a private backyard area. Upper level offers two spacious bedrooms with ample closet space and a full bathroom. Hardwood floors throughout. Wall A/C units included. The lower level offers over 590 sq. ft. of flexible space, ideal for a family room, home office, gym, or additional room, as well as laundry and storage areas in the unit. Two assigned parking spaces are included, along with visitor parking. Conveniently located near the Merritt Parkway, public transportation, shopping, and dining. Tenant is responsible for electricity and cable/internet.
